snippet.description:
✅ Find the Radius of Curvature for Cartesian Curves in this B.Sc Calculus lecture. Learn the formula derivation and solve practice examples for better understanding of Cartesian coordinates.

📲 Connect with Fractal Frontier:
📱 Telegram: https://t.me/fractalfrontiermaths
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mathsworld007
🌐 Website: https://drpraveendra.org
📝 Lecture Notes and Previous Year Question Papers: https://drpraveendra.org/resources

Aaj ke is video mein hum "Curvature of Cartesian Curves" ke baare mein detail mein baat karenge. Humne last lecture mein basic concepts aur intrinsic equations ko dekha tha, lekin aaj hum focus karenge Cartesian curves ($y = f(x)$) par.

Is video mein aap seekhenge:

✅  Cartesian curves ke liye Radius of Curvature ($\rho$) ka formula kaise derive karte hain.
✅  Formula: $\rho = \frac{[1 + (y_1)^2]^{3/2}}{y_2}$ ka use kaise karein.
✅  Important examples jaise Foliuim of Descartes aur Astroid curves ke questions solve karna.
✅  Different points par curvature calculate karne ki tips and tricks.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 – Introduction and Recap of Basic Concepts
01:25 – Understanding Curvature for Cartesian Curves
02:02 – Formula Derivation for Radius of Curvature ($\rho$)
06:27 – Short Form of the Curvature Formula
06:58 – Important Note on Coordinate Systems
08:27 – How to Solve Questions (Explicit vs Implicit)
10:10 – Example 1: Proving Curvature for $y = ax/(a+x)$
18:41 – Example 2: Finding Radius of Curvature at a Specific Point ($\pi/2$)
22:12 – Example 3: Proving Radius of Curvature for Catenary
26:55 – Example 4: Radius of Curvature for Folium of Descartes (Implicit)
35:15 – Example 5: Curvature of an Astroid and its Tangent Property
51:11 – Practice Exercise for Students
52:27 – Summary and Conclusion

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Introduction to Curvature | Radius of Curvature & Intrinsic Equation
→ https://youtu.be/Ir239E3Td1k

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd
